name: python_keywords
description: Fill missing Python syntax keywords in small code fragments; matched control extracts the identifier from the same fragment.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
forms=[('___ {n}(x):
    return x','def'),('def {n}(x):
    ___ x','return'),('class {n}:
    ___','pass'),('{n} = ___ x: x + 1','lambda'),('___ {n}:
    pass','class'),('___ {n} as module','import'),('try:
    {n}()
___ ValueError:
    pass','except'),('def {n}(xs):
    for x in xs:
        ___ x','yield')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 n=random.choice(['alpha','beta','delta','gamma','sample','result','helper','worker']);form,answer=forms[i%len(forms)];code=form.format(n=n)
 p='Python snippet:
'+code+'
'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Replace ___ with the correct Python keyword. Answer:','answer':' '+answer})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Which identifier is used, excluding x, xs, module, and ValueError? Answer:','answer':' '+n})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
